source: #202 exposed development games at 25 ms, both colors; roots at 8, 32 and 64 searched plies from the book exit when the game is still live
tree: Both r85 HCE and unscaled no-pawn trees in separate runs, fixed 10000 nodes, full root game history, no deadline, 111 maximum depth, root seed 0xC0FFEE.
samples: Two deterministic six-event reservoirs per root, one over all stand-pat visits, one restricted to the tree evaluator within 50 cp of its active cutoff bound. Keep repeated visits as visits; do not pool the strata.
comparators: half no-pawn, signed truncation toward zero
label: Independent 12000-node UCI search per unique sampled leaf and teacher, fresh OS process, no earlier leaf history. For a searched mate use signed 3000 cp for threshold classification only; exclude mates from CP error. Exclude one-sided bound-only CP scores from both metrics and report coverage.
estimands: Each root equally weighted within its stratum. Absolute error and error>=200cp over exact CP labels. Cutoff-proxy disagreement, adverse early stops and missed stops versus teacher sign of crossing the tree-specific bound. The deeper teacher may find tactical moves, so a missed stop denotes an opportunity only. No inference to strength or production frequency.
use: Independent exploratory diagnosis, zero use in candidate fitting or selection.
exploratoryExtension: Original HCE-only one-process-per-teacher pilot used UCI new-game and found larger apparent disagreement for the alternatives near HCE cutoffs. Its protocol SHA-256 was ed47f56733cd1c531e7cadbcc9ee0cb2bdd29f1efa04c3b4aa07c003c08bacf6. Registering the reciprocal no-pawn tree and isolating every teacher query tests sampling and state dependence. No model selected or edited from these results.
